plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.
This strategy aims for a large cash buffer and low drawdown.
Focus on broad index and top-quality names for stability.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and maintaining a substantial cash buffer. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to reduce overall leverage.
Trim QQQI to 25% to cure the concentration breach.
Buy TSLA at 4% as a strong scanner setup to blend quality tech.
This plan balances broad index exposure with some quality tech and a small amount of leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-scoring scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of stability and growth potential.

plan: Add to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to increase exposure in line with aggressive growth.
Trim QQQI to 25% to cure the concentration breach.
Buy TSLA at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup, pressing what is working.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups for stretch growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential; leveraged ETFs decay daily, and losses can be substantial if strict stop discipline is not maintained.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to increase income exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
Rotate into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index for yield.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It cuts all leveraged and high-beta single names to near zero, prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
